title: Did Recent Inflation Reflect a Nonlinear Phillips Curve?
title_zh: 近期通胀是否反映了非线性的菲利普斯曲线？
title_primary: 近期通胀是否反映了非线性的菲利普斯曲线？

authors: Beaudry, Paul, Hou, Chenyu, Portier, Franck
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: To examine the potential role of a nonlinear Phillips curve in explaining recent US inflation, we combine evidence from both crosscity variation and aggregate time series data. A central challenge relates to how best to control for the potential confounding effect of inflation expectations. The paper explores several options. Our findings place into question the robustness that tight labour markets, due to a nonlinear Phillips curve, played a very important role in the recent inflation episode.
abstract_zh: 为探究非线性菲利普斯曲线在解释近期美国通胀中的潜在作用，我们结合了跨城市差异与总体时间序列数据的证据。核心挑战在于如何最优地控制通胀预期可能产生的混杂效应。本文探讨了多种解决方案。研究结果表明，由于非线性菲利普斯曲线的存在，劳动力市场紧张在近期通胀事件中发挥重要作用的结论缺乏稳健性。

title_primary: 转移风险、加成率与贸易信贷的融资成本优势
title_secondary: Diversion Risk, Markups, and the Financing Cost Advantage of Trade Credit
authors: Garcia-Marin, Alvaro, Justel, Santiago, Schmidt-Eisenlohr, Tim
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Trade credit is a key source of short-term finance. This paper develops a model where trade credit reduces borrowing from banks. This reduction gives rise to a financing cost advantage of trade credit that increases in the product of markups and borrowing costs. Chilean export data confirm this prediction. A one-standard-deviation rise in upstream markups increases trade credit by 9 days. The intensive margin is responsible for about 60 percent of this effect, which strengthens with destination-country borrowing costs. We estimate that trade credit allows U.S. firms to reduce formal borrowing by $1.4 trillion, generating annual savings of $39 billion.
abstract_zh: 贸易信贷是短期融资的关键来源。本文构建了一个模型，其中贸易信贷减少了企业从银行的借款。这种减少使得贸易信贷产生融资成本优势，该优势随加成率与借款成本的乘积递增。智利出口数据证实了这一预测：上游加成率每上升一个标准差，贸易信贷期限将增加9天。集约边际对此效应的贡献约为60%，且该效应随目的地国借款成本的上升而增强。我们估算，贸易信贷使美国企业减少1.4万亿美元的正规借款，每年节省390亿美元。

title: The dictatorial public goods game
authors: Gabriele Camera, Gary Charness, Nir Chemaya, Ro’i Zultan
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We propose a novel game, the Dictatorial Public Goods Game , to study the interplay between collective resource generation and centralized provision of public goods. After making choices in a standard Voluntary Contribution Mechanism (VCM), one player is selected from the group to administrate the contributions: either provide the public good or expropriate the collected resources for personal gain. We find that adding this centralized mechanism reduces efficiency compared to the standard VCM. Although higher contributions increase the material incentive to expropriate, they lead to more provision. Thus, pro-social choices in the contribution and in the provision stages act as complements, reflecting the generation of social capital in the group. Administrators tend to provide more when the statutory default is expropriation rather than provision. This counter status-quo effect is in line with the standard provision-maintenance gap in the literature, but is not explained by the theoretical arguments typically invoked to explain such framing effects.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的博弈——独裁性公共品博弈，用以研究集体资源生成与公共品集中供给之间的相互作用。在标准自愿贡献机制（VCM）中做出选择后，从群体中选出一名玩家来管理贡献：要么提供公共品，要么将收集的资源据为己有。我们发现，与标准VCM相比，加入这一集中机制会降低效率。尽管更高的贡献增加了侵占的物质激励，但它们反而导致了更多的供给。因此，贡献阶段和供给阶段的亲社会行为互为补充，反映了群体中社会资本的生成。当法定默认设置为侵占而非供给时，管理者倾向于提供更多。这种反现状效应与文献中标准的供给-维护缺口一致，但无法用通常用于解释此类框架效应的理论论点来解释。

title: Formal Labor Market Dynamics and Development
title_zh: 正规劳动力市场动态与发展
title_primary: 正规劳动力市场动态与发展
title_secondary: Formal Labor Market Dynamics and Development
authors: Anne Brockmeyer, François Gerard, Gabriel Ulyssea, Linda Wu, Marcelo Bergolo 等
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies formal employment dynamics using linked employer-employee data from eight countries spanning a wide income range from Kenya to Chile. First, we show that formality rates increase with development, both between and within countries, because more workers enter the formal sector, not because they spend more time in formal jobs. Second, formal labor market fluidity increases with development, as workers hold more formal jobs, spend less time in each job, and less time between jobs. Third, greater fluidity is associated with higher life-cycle wage growth, which is largely accounted for by within- rather than between-firm wage gains.
abstract_zh: 本文利用涵盖从肯尼亚到智利等八个收入水平差异显著国家的关联雇主-雇员数据，研究正规就业的动态变化。首先，我们发现正规就业率随经济发展而上升，这一趋势既体现在国家间也体现在国家内部，其原因是更多劳动者进入正规部门，而非他们在正规岗位上的工作时间延长。其次，正规劳动力市场的流动性随经济发展而增强，表现为劳动者从事更多正规工作、每份工作持续时间缩短、以及工作转换间隔时间减少。第三，更高的流动性伴随着更显著的职业生涯工资增长，这主要归因于企业内部而非企业间的工资提升。

title: Court Capture, Local Protectionism, and Economic Integration: Evidence from China
title_zh: 法院俘获、地方保护主义与经济一体化：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 法院俘获、地方保护主义与经济一体化：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Court Capture, Local Protectionism, and Economic Integration: Evidence from China
authors: Ernest Liu, Yi Lu, Wenwei Peng, Shaoda Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Court capture in developing countries is pervasive, yet its economic effects remain underexplored. We study a Chinese reform that transferred financial and personnel authority over local courts from local to provincial governments. Exploiting the staggered roll-out, we find a 7.3% decline in local defendants’ win rates against non-local plaintiffs, alongside improved judicial quality. The reform encouraged smaller non-local firms to litigate and attracted non-local investment, potentially raising GDP by 1.9%. Yet favoritism toward politically connected firms and inter-provincial protectionism remain, and centralization itself promotes less qualified judges— revealing both its promise and limits.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家普遍存在法院被地方俘获的现象，但其经济影响尚未得到充分研究。本文研究了中国将地方法院的财政与人事管理权从地方政府转移至省级政府的改革。利用该改革分阶段推行的特征，我们发现本地被告对非本地原告的胜诉率下降7.3%，同时司法质量得到提升。改革鼓励小型非本地企业提起诉讼并吸引非本地投资，可能使GDP增长1.9%。然而，对政治关联企业的偏袒及省际保护主义依然存在，且集权化本身导致法官资质下降——这揭示了改革的成效与局限。

title: Common Agent or Double Agent? Pharmacy Benefit Managers in the Prescription Drug Market
title_zh: 共同代理人还是双重代理人？处方药市场中的药品福利管理者
title_primary: 共同代理人还是双重代理人？处方药市场中的药品福利管理者
title_secondary: Common Agent or Double Agent? Pharmacy Benefit Managers in the Prescription Drug Market
authors: Rena M. Conti, Brigham Frandsen, Michael Powell, James B. Rebitzer
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Pharmacy benefit managers dominate the U.S. pharmaceutical market but are controversial and poorly understood. We analyze PBMs as market intermediaries that operate formulary contests in which on-patent brand-drug makers compete for favorable placement by offering rebates off list price. These formulary contests deliver efficiency gains compared to drug makers selling directly to consumers; PBMs capture some of these gains. Our approach answers key questions regarding the determinants of efficiency, rebates, list prices, and PBM market power in the pharmaceutical market. Our analysis also explains how common contracting practices, federal regulations, and incentives within formulary contests can undermine market efficiency.
abstract_zh: 药品福利管理公司主导着美国药品市场，但颇具争议且认知度较低。我们将PBM视为市场中介机构，其运作处方集竞争机制——专利品牌药制造商通过提供标价折扣来争夺有利的处方集地位。相较于药企直接面向消费者销售的模式，这种处方集竞争机制能带来效率提升；PBM则从中获取部分收益。我们的分析框架解答了关于药品市场效率决定因素、折扣机制、标价形成及PBM市场势力的关键问题。研究同时揭示了处方集竞争中的常见合同实践、联邦监管规定及激励机制如何可能削弱市场效率。

title: Monetary policy transmission in India – a coefficient-restricted VAR approach
title_zh: 印度货币政策传导——系数受限VAR方法
title_primary: 印度货币政策传导——系数受限VAR方法
title_secondary: Monetary policy transmission in India – a coefficient-restricted VAR approach
authors: Joyal P. Joseph, Santosh Kumar Dash
abstract: The empirical literature on monetary policy transmission to output and inflation remains inconclusive, with varying results stemming from differences in the choice of policy variables and methodologies. This study uses a coefficient-restricted vector Autoregression (RVAR) model, relatively less explored in the Indian context, to analyse the monetary policy transmission to output and inflation via interest, credit, and exchange rate channels. RVAR provides a relatively effective transmission channel by restricting the impact of parallel channels without assuming any contemporaneous relations. The impulse responses using the quarterly data from 2001–02 Q1 to 2021–22 Q2 reveal that a one-unit shock in the Weighted Average Call Money rate (WACMR) leads to a 0.77% and 0.15% fall in growth and inflation, respectively, through interest channel, while the respective fall is 0.78% and 0.20% via credit channel. The study also finds that the exchange rate channel has the opposite effect, with the credit channel being stronger than the interest rate channel, contrary to majority of the existing literature. KEYWORDS: Monetary policy RBI inflation VAR coefficient-restricted VAR JEL CLASSIFICATION: E52 E58 E31 C32 Acknowledgements This paper has greatly benefited from the insightful comments of the editor and reviewers, to whom we extend our sincere gratitude. We also express our heartfelt thanks to Dr. Kiran Kumar Kakarlapudi for his unwavering guidance and support throughout the study. We would also like to acknowledge Prof. KJ Joseph and Dr. Anoop S Kumar for their helpful feedback during the course of this research. Any remaining errors are our own.
abstract_zh: 关于货币政策传导至产出与通胀的实证研究仍无定论，不同研究因政策变量选择和方法论差异而结论各异。本研究采用在印度语境中较少探索的系数约束向量自回归（RVAR）模型，通过利率、信贷和汇率渠道分析货币政策对产出与通胀的传导效应。RVAR模型通过限制平行渠道的冲击影响，且无需假设同期关系，从而提供相对有效的传导渠道分析。基于2001-02财年第一季度至2021-22财年第二季度的季度数据脉冲响应分析显示：加权平均隔夜拆借利率（WACMR）一个单位冲击通过利率渠道导致增长率和通胀率分别下降0.77%和0.15%，而通过信贷渠道的相应降幅则为0.78%和0.20%。研究同时发现汇率渠道呈现反向效应，且信贷渠道强于利率渠道，这与现有文献的主流结论相悖。 关键词：货币政策 印度储备银行 通胀 VAR 系数约束VAR JEL分类：E52 E58 E31 C32 致谢：本文得益于编辑与审稿人的真知灼见，谨致诚挚谢意。我们衷心感谢Kiran Kumar Kakarlapudi博士在整个研究过程中给予的坚定指导与支持。同时感谢KJ Joseph教授与Anoop S Kumar博士在研究期间提供的宝贵反馈。文责自负。
